scope.description: Evaluation of 4 complete rear unarmed body cycles (Orc V1): 3 newly authored cycles (back_r/Sword, back_l/Sword, back_l/Axe) plus 1 preserved canonical cycle (back_r/Axe)

temporalPerception.notes: Direct visual inspection executed via multimodal image decoding on all native strips, composite strips, individual frames, and contact strips. Real-time continuous 1x motion in live engine/browser was not observed in live playback; frame-by-frame and transition progression inspected across all 12 frames per cycle.

findings.symptom: Prominent curved white/light-cyan sword slash swoosh/blade trail baked directly into the unarmed body cel.
findings.evidence: 272 bright pixels (rgba > 180, 180, 180, 255) forming a curved slash arc from right pauldron (x:105, y:20) down across flank, groin mail, and right leg shin to (x:30, y:110).
findings.cause: AI generation bridge for descent intermediate hallucinated a weapon VFX/slash arc on the unarmed body prompt; uncleaned during Aseprite assembly.
findings.impact: Violation of layers-off policy and Lesson 15 (weapon contamination). Will produce double-blade / visual ghosting collision when separate equipment layers are composed.
findings.safeSuggestion: Cirurgically erase/clean out the 272 bright slash trail pixels in Aseprite batch; restore underlying leg/armor pixels from F05/F07.

findings.symptom: Complete iron axe head and wooden haft drawn directly on the unarmed body sprite, resting over the right shoulder.
findings.evidence: Axe blade profile at x:85..108, y:10..22 and brown haft at x:70..85, y:18..24 held by the right hand.
findings.cause: Intermediate generation frame F02 introduced a drawn axe on the body and was incorporated without layers-off scrubbing (identical to legacy QA-02).
findings.impact: Direct violation of layers-off policy and Lesson 15. Causes weapon pop-in at F02 and sudden disappearance at F03 (hoist), duplicating silhouette upon equipment attachment.
findings.safeSuggestion: Cirurgically erase the axe head and haft in Aseprite; re-author right hand in F02 as an empty clenched leather glove transitioning from F01 to F03.

findings.symptom: Stray 7-pixel black squiggly filament/antenna protruding vertically into empty air between the right pauldron and right wrist.
findings.evidence: Coordinates x:95..96, y:28..33 contain a 7-pixel vertical hook present only in F05 (absent in F04 and F06), causing a 1-frame silhouette pop during descent.
findings.cause: AI generation artifact on pauldron contour not cleaned during assembly (resembling legacy QA-04).
findings.impact: Medium cosmetic silhouette defect and visual noise.
findings.safeSuggestion: Cirurgically erase the 7 stray pixels in Aseprite batch to restore clean negative space between pauldron and wrist.

anatomicalEvaluation.counterbalance: Left arm acts as dynamic stabilizer throughout all 12 frames without frozen copy-paste
anatomicalEvaluation.heavyImpactPhysics: Genuine whole-body delivery: neck compresses, knees bend, hips sink into impact at F07
anatomicalEvaluation.impactHandSeparation: Right glove distinctly articulated against hip/thigh (repair1 fix confirmed)
